name: DARJEELING 5N-6D(Darjeeling-Pelling-Zuluk)
overview: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Eastern Himalayas on this 5 Nights & 6 Days tour covering Darjeeling, Pelling and Zuluk. Begin your journey in the charming hill town of Darjeeling, where you can enjoy the spectacular Tiger Hill sunrise, Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, tea gardens and Mall Road. Continue to Pelling, known for its peaceful monasteries, beautiful valleys and magnificent views of Kanchenjunga, with visits to Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse Ruins, Khecheopalri Lake and Pelling Skywalk. The journey then takes you to Zuluk, a scenic high-altitude village on the historic Silk Route, offering breathtaking mountain roads, winding hairpin bends and panoramic Himalayan views from places such as Thambi View Point, Lungthung and Nathang Valley. This carefully planned tour combines nature, culture, adventure, mountain sightseeing and peaceful hill experiences, making it an ideal getaway for families, couples and nature lovers looking to explore the diverse beauty of Darjeeling and Sikkim.
highlights: Tea Garden Visit Mall Road & Chowrasta

itinerary.title: NJP/IXB TO DARJEELING DROP
itinerary.description: Arrive at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport (IXB) and meet our representative. Proceed towards Darjeeling through scenic Himalayan roads, enjoying beautiful tea gardens, forests and mountain landscapes. On arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. In the evening, enjoy leisure time at Mall Road and Chowrasta, with opportunities for local shopping and enjoying the mountain atmosphere.
itinerary.highlights_chips: NJP/IXB Pickup • Scenic Himalayan Drive • Tea Garden Views • Mountain Landscapes • Mall Road • Chowrasta • Local Shopping • Evening Leisure

itinerary.title: DARJEELING FULL TO DAY SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.description: Start early with a visit to Tiger Hill to experience the spectacular sunrise over the Himalayas and, subject to weather conditions, views of Kanchenjunga. Return via Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop. After breakfast, visit the Darjeeling Tea Garden, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park and Tenzing Rock. Later, enjoy free time around Chowrasta and Mall Road.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Tiger Hill Sunrise • Kanchenjunga Views • Ghoom Monastery • Batasia Loop • Tea Garden • HMI • Himalayan Zoological Park • Tenzing Rock • Mall Road

itinerary.title: DARJEELING TO PELLING DROP
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from Darjeeling and proceed towards Pelling. Enjoy a scenic journey through the beautiful Himalayan foothills, forests, valleys and picturesque villages. On arrival in Pelling, check in to the hotel and relax. Spend the evening enjoying the peaceful surroundings and panoramic mountain views.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Darjeeling–Pelling Scenic Drive • Himalayan Valleys • Forest Landscapes • Village Views • Mountain Photography • Kanchenjunga Views • Pelling Leisure

itinerary.title: PELLING FULL TO DAY SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore Pelling's famous attractions. Visit Pemayangtse Monastery, one of Sikkim's important monasteries, followed by the historic Rabdentse Ruins. Continue to the peaceful Khecheopalri Lake, surrounded by lush forests. Visit the Sky Walk and Chenrezig Statue for panoramic Himalayan views, followed by Kanchenjunga Falls. Return to the hotel after sightseeing.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Pemayangtse Monastery • Rabdentse Ruins • Khecheopalri Lake • Sky Walk • Chenrezig Statue • Kanchenjunga Falls • Himalayan Views • Photography

itinerary.title: PELLING TO ZULUK DROP
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Zuluk through the scenic mountain roads of Sikkim. Continue towards the historic Old Silk Route, enjoying spectacular Himalayan landscapes, deep valleys and winding zig-zag roads. On arrival at Zuluk, check in to your hotel/homestay and relax. Enjoy the peaceful mountain surroundings and, if weather permits, beautiful sunset views.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Pelling–Zuluk Drive • Old Silk Route • Zuluk Village • Zig-Zag Mountain Roads • Himalayan Valleys • Scenic Viewpoints • Photography • Sunset Views

itinerary.title: ZULUK TO NJP/IXB DEPARTURE
itinerary.description: Start your morning with beautiful Himalayan scenery around Zuluk and, subject to weather conditions, enjoy the sunrise over the Eastern Himalayas. After breakfast, begin your return journey towards NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport (IXB). Enjoy the final views of the Silk Route and Himalayan foothills before your onward journey.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Zuluk Sunrise • Himalayan Views • Silk Route Drive • Mountain Photography • Scenic Foothills • NJP Railway Station Drop • Bagdogra Airport Drop

name: Bhutan (Phuentsholing –Thimphu–Paro) 5N/6D
overview: Experience the magical beauty of Bhutan on a memorable 5 Nights & 6 Days journey covering 1 Night in Phuentsholing, 2 Nights in Thimphu and 2 Nights in Paro. Explore Bhutan’s peaceful valleys, rich culture, ancient monasteries, majestic dzongs and breathtaking Himalayan landscapes. Highlights include Phuentsholing, Buddha Dordenma, Tashichho Dzong, Memorial Chorten, Paro Rinpung Dzong, Kyichu Lhakhang and the iconic Tiger’s Nest Monastery. This scenic Bhutan getaway offers a perfect blend of nature, spirituality, culture and Himalayan adventure.
highlights: Thimphu Market Paro: Tiger’s Nest Monastery (Taktsang)

itinerary.title: Pickup from IXB/NJP to Phuentsholing
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Bagdogra Airport (IXB), meet our representative and begin your scenic journey towards Phuentsholing, the gateway to Bhutan. Enjoy the beautiful drive through lush green landscapes, tea gardens and picturesque surroundings. On arrival, complete the necessary entry formalities and check in to the hotel. Spend the evening at leisure, relax and explore the local surroundings of Phuentsholing. Overnight stay in Phuentsholing/Jaigaon.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Pickup from IXB/NJP Scenic Drive to Phuentsholing Tea Garden & Countryside Views Bhutan Entry Formalities Hotel Check-in & Leisure

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing to Thimphu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel, after completing all the immigration process & Permits. Proceed towards Thimphu, the capital city of Bhutan. Enjoy a scenic drive through winding mountain roads, lush valleys, forests and beautiful Himalayan landscapes. En route, experience the changing scenery as you gradually enter the heart of Bhutan. On arrival in Thimphu, check in to the hotel and relax. If time permits, enjoy a short evening walk around the city and explore the local market. Overnight stay in Thimphu.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Immigration & Entry Formalities Permit Processing Scenic Drive to Thimphu Himalayan Mountain & Valley Views Hotel Check-in & Leisure

itinerary.title: Thimphu Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day sightseeing tour of Thimphu, exploring the cultural and scenic highlights of Bhutan’s capital city. Visit the magnificent Buddha Dordenma Statue, Memorial Chorten, Tashichho Dzong, Motithang Takin Preserve and Kuensel Phodrang. Enjoy the city’s peaceful atmosphere, traditional Bhutanese architecture and beautiful Himalayan surroundings. In the evening, explore the local market and enjoy some leisure time in Thimphu before returning to the hotel. Overnight stay in Thimphu.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Buddha Dordenma Statue Memorial Chorten Tashichho Dzong Motithang Takin Preserve Kuensel Phodrang Local Market & City Walk

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha via Dochula Pass
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive towards **Punakha**, enjoying a scenic journey through the beautiful Himalayan landscapes of Bhutan. En route, visit **Dochula Pass**, famous for its 108 Druk Wangyal Chortens and panoramic mountain views. Continue the drive through lush valleys and winding mountain roads to Punakha. On arrival, visit the magnificent **Punakha Dzong**, situated at the confluence of the Mo Chhu and Pho Chhu rivers. Later, check in to the hotel and relax amidst the peaceful surroundings of Punakha. Overnight stay in Punakha.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Scenic Drive to Punakha Dochula Pass Visit 108 Druk Wangyal Chortens Himalayan Mountain Views Punakha Dzong Visit Hotel Check-in & Leisure

itinerary.title: Punakha to Paro
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed towards Paro, enjoying a scenic drive through Bhutan’s beautiful mountain landscapes and valleys. En route, enjoy the breathtaking views from Dochula Pass and visit Simtokha Dzong, subject to route and time conditions. Continue towards Paro and, on arrival, visit the historic Paro Rinpung Dzong and explore the charming Paro town. Later, check in to the hotel and relax amidst the peaceful surroundings of the Paro Valley. Overnight stay in Paro.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Scenic Drive to Paro Himalayan Mountain & Valley Views Paro Rinpung Dzong Visit Paro Town Exploration Hotel Check-in & Leisure

itinerary.title: Paro (Hike to Tiger’s Nest)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for the highlight of your Bhutan journey—the famous Tiger’s Nest Monastery (Taktsang Monastery). Begin the scenic hike through beautiful pine forests and mountain trails, enjoying breathtaking views of the Paro Valley along the way. Reach the spectacular monastery perched dramatically on a cliff and spend time exploring this sacred and historic site. After completing the hike, descend back and return to Paro town. Evening is free for relaxation, shopping or exploring the local surroundings. Overnight stay in Paro.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Tiger’s Nest Monastery Visit Hiking Through Pine Forests Mountain & Paro Valley Views Monastery Exploration Photography Return to Paro & Leisure

itinerary.title: Paro to IXB/NJP Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed from Paro to Bagdogra Airport (IXB) for your onward journey. Enjoy the scenic drive through Bhutan and the beautiful Himalayan landscapes along the way. On arrival at IXB, your memorable Bhutan tour comes to an end with wonderful memories of the journey.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Hotel Check-out Scenic Drive to IXB Himalayan Landscape Views Airport Drop-off at Bagdogra Departure & Tour Completion

name: DARJEELING 4N-5D
destination: Kurseong – Where the Hills Meet the Clouds
overview: Day 1: Arrive in Kalimpong and explore Deolo Hill, Durpin Monastery, Cactus Nursery, and Morgan House, enjoying beautiful Himalayan views and peaceful surroundings before your overnight stay in Kalimpong. Day 2: After breakfast, drive to Darjeeling, check in to your hotel, and spend the evening exploring Chowrasta and Mall Road, enjoying local cafés, shopping, and the charming hill-town atmosphere. Day 3: Begin with the spectacular Tiger Hill sunrise, followed by Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop, then visit the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Peace Pagoda, and Happy Valley Tea Estate before returning to your hotel. Day 4: After breakfast, drive to Kurseong, a peaceful hill town surrounded by tea gardens and misty mountains, and visit Eagle’s Craig, Dow Hill, and nearby tea gardens before enjoying a relaxing evening and overnight stay. Day 5: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Bagdogra Airport/NJP Railway Station or your next destination, concluding your memorable Kalimpong, Darjeeling, and Kurseong Himalayan journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival at NJP/IXB – Transfer to Kalimpong
itinerary.description: Arrive at NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) and meet our representative. Begin your scenic drive towards Kalimpong, enjoying the beautiful Himalayan landscapes, green valleys and winding mountain roads. On arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. Later, enjoy leisure time exploring the local surroundings and Kalimpong Market. Overnight stay in Kalimpong.
itinerary.highlights_chips: 🚗 NJP/IXB Pickup • 🏔️ Scenic Himalayan Drive • 🌊 Teesta River Views • 🌿 Mountain Landscapes • 🛍️ Kalimpong Market • 📸 Photography • 🏨 Hotel Check-in

itinerary.title: Kalimpong Sightseeing – Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for Kalimpong sightseeing. Visit Deolo Hill, offering panoramic views of the Himalayan mountains and surrounding valleys, followed by Durpin Dara Hill for spectacular views of Kalimpong and the Teesta River. Explore Zang Dhok Palri Phodang Monastery and Pine View Nursery. Later, drive towards Darjeeling through scenic mountain roads. Check in at the hotel and spend the evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.
itinerary.highlights_chips: 🏔️ Deolo Hill • 🌄 Durpin Dara Hill • 🛕 Zang Dhok Palri Phodang Monastery • 🌺 Pine View Nursery • 📸 Scenic Photography • 🚗 Kalimpong–Darjeeling Drive • 🍃 Tea Garden Views • 🏨 Darjeeling Hotel Stay

itinerary.description: Start the day early with an unforgettable visit to Tiger Hill to witness the beautiful sunrise over Mount Kanchenjunga. On the way back, visit Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop. After breakfast, continue Darjeeling sightseeing with visits to the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tenzing Rock, Tea Garden, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre and other popular attractions. In the evening, enjoy a relaxing walk around Darjeeling Mall Road / Chowrasta. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

Enjoy the beautiful tea gardens, misty mountain scenery and colonial charm along the route. On arrival, visit attractions such as Eagle’s Craig, Dow Hill, Forest Museum, Makaibari Tea Estate and Kurseong viewpoints. Spend the evening enjoying the calm atmosphere of the hills. Overnight stay in Kurseong.
itinerary.highlights_chips: 🚗 Darjeeling–Kurseong Scenic Drive • 🌄 Eagle’s Craig • 🌲 Dow Hill • 🍃 Makaibari Tea Estate • 🏔️ Kurseong Valley Views • 📸 Photography • ☕ Tea Experience • 🌅 Evening Leisure

name: DOOARS TOUR PACKAGE – 3N/4D
overview: Discover the enchanting beauty of Dooars, a paradise of dense forests, sprawling tea gardens, winding rivers and the majestic Himalayan foothills. This exciting tour takes you through the region’s most beautiful and wildlife-rich destinations, including Gorumara National Park, Jaldapara National Park, Chilapata Forest, Buxa Tiger Reserve, Murti and Jainti. Experience thrilling jungle safaris and get the opportunity to spot fascinating wildlife such as the one-horned rhinoceros, elephants, deer and a variety of colourful birds in their natural surroundings. Enjoy the peaceful beauty of the Murti and Jainti rivers, scenic forest roads, lush tea estates and charming local villages. With a perfect combination of wildlife, nature, adventure, scenic landscapes and relaxation, the Dooars tour is an ideal escape for families, couples, nature lovers, photographers and adventure enthusiasts looking to experience the untouched beauty of North Bengal.
highlights: 🌳 Gorumara National Park 🐘 Jaldapara National Park

On arrival at Lataguri, check in to your resort and relax. Later, enjoy the peaceful surroundings of Murti River and explore the nearby forest area.

Proceed to Lachen and visit the breathtaking Gurudongmar Lake, enjoying the pristine Himalayan scenery before returning to NJP/Bagdogra for departure.

overview: The Sikkim–Darjeeling 5 Nights/6 Days tour via Pelling is a wonderful journey through the scenic mountains of Northeast India, offering a perfect combination of nature, culture, monasteries, and breathtaking Himalayan views. The trip begins with exploring the beautiful landscapes of Sikkim, followed by a visit to Pelling, a peaceful hill destination famous for its stunning views of the Kanchenjunga range, monasteries, waterfalls, and lush green valleys. The journey then continues to Darjeeling, one of India’s most popular hill stations, known for its famous tea gardens, colonial charm, toy train, and spectacular sunrise views over the Himalayas. During the tour, travelers can enjoy beautiful mountain roads, local cuisine, traditional culture, peaceful surroundings, and refreshing weather. This 5 Nights/6 Days Sikkim–Darjeeling tour via Pelling is ideal for tourists looking for a memorable Himalayan holiday filled with scenic beauty, relaxation, and unforgettable experiences.

Pelling and finishes in Darjeeling. This route blends mountain views

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station(NJP)/Bagdogra Airport(IXB) – Gangtok (130 km/4 hrs drive)
itinerary.description: Arrival at NJP/Bagdogra. After a warm welcome, our representative will drive you to Gangtok (1437 m) and assist you to check in at the hotel. Freshen up and relax for some time. In the evening, you can go for a stroll on the MG Marg. Stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir & Nathula Pass
itinerary.description: After a leisurely breakfast, at around 8 am leave for Tsomgo Lake (12,400 ft/3750 m/3 hrs drive) and Baba Harbhajan Mandir( 13,200 ft/4000 m). The zig-zag road through craggy mountain terrain takes you to Tsomgo Lake. Located at an altitude of 12,400 ft, the lake is enveloped in ethereal beauty and is considered sacred. The lake dons different looks in different seasons. In winters it gets covered in snow while in spring colourful flowers around the lake add life to it. Baba Harbhajan Mandir or the shrine is a must-visit place of Sikkim as it is dedicated to Baba Harbhajan Singh who was a brave Indian soldier. While carrying supplies to a remote post he died near the Nathula Pass in eastern Sikkim due to bad weather condition. After the excursion, we will drive you back to Gangtok. Stay overnight at the hotel. Note: You can also visit Nathula Pass on the same day at an additional cost. Nathula Pass is located at an altitude of 14,140 feet and is one of the highest motorable passes of India. It is one of the oldest trading border posts linking India and Tibet.
itinerary.highlights_chips: After Breakfast Visit Tsomgo (Changu) Lake Baba Mandir Optional: Nathula Pass (subject to permit, weather and road conditions) Return to Gangtok Evening free at MG Marg Overnight: Gangtok

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Pelling(120 km/5.5 hrs drive)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we will drive you to Pelling. The journey from Gangtok to Pelling is pleasing as you will drive past the gorgeous tea gardens, majestic mountains, and scenic landscape. Pelling is a lovely town located amidst the pine forest. It offers great views of snow-capped mountains and the might Kangchenjunga. It is also a home to age-old monasteries. After a long drive of more than 5 hours you will be tired, so take rest and spend the rest of the day at leisure.
itinerary.highlights_chips: Breakfast and checkout Drive to Pelling (approx. 4–5 hrs) En route, Check in at Pelling Evening at leisure Overnight: Pelling

itinerary.title: Pelling local sightseeing & transfer to Darjeeling.
itinerary.description: DAY 5 : Pelling (Full day local sightseeing) After breakfast, get ready to explore the local attractions of Pelling. Start with Kanchenjunga waterfalls which will surely rejuvenate you to the hilt with its gushing water and green surroundings. Then head to the picturesque Sewaro rock garden full of greenery and beauty. Next on the list is Darap Valley which is a scenic retreat. Take a break for lunch and continue with the sightseeing visiting Pema Yangtse monastery, Helipad Ground, Rimbi waterfalls, Khecheopalri sacred Lake and Rabdentse Ruins. The drive may not be very smooth but on the journey, you will come across gorgeous green gardens, rivers, quaint villages and old bridges. Reach the hotel in Darjeeling, check in and stay overnight.

It is the highest point of this hill station. While coming back from there visit Batasia Loop and Ghoom Monastery. Enjoy a good breakfast and then visit Japanese Temple which reflects traditional Japanese architecture and is a well known Buddhist pilgrimage. Other attractions which will be covered are Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park(closed on Thursday), Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Tenzing Rock, Peace Pagoda and Chitrey Tea Garden(outer view). name: BHUTAN 3N-4D OCT
overview: Experience the peaceful beauty and unique culture of Bhutan on this wonderful 3 Nights & 4 Days Bhutan tour, covering 1 Night in Thimphu and 2 Nights in Paro. Begin your journey with a scenic drive to Thimphu, the charming capital city of Bhutan, surrounded by beautiful Himalayan landscapes. Explore the city’s cultural attractions, traditional architecture and local markets before continuing to Paro, one of Bhutan’s most picturesque valleys. Discover ancient monasteries, historic landmarks and stunning mountain scenery while enjoying Bhutan’s peaceful atmosphere and traditional way of life. The highlight of the trip is the famous Tiger’s Nest Monastery (Taktsang), dramatically located on a cliff above the Paro Valley. This short Bhutan getaway is perfect for families, couples and travellers looking for a refreshing combination of nature, culture, spirituality and Himalayan adventure.

name: SIKKIM-DARJEELING(via Zuluk) 4N-5D
destination: Zuluk – Silk Route Advanture & Himalayan Views
overview: Experience an unforgettable 4 Nights & 5 Days Himalayan journey covering the scenic destinations of Zuluk, Namchi and Darjeeling. Begin your tour from NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport and travel towards Zuluk through the historic Silk Route, enjoying spectacular mountain landscapes, winding roads and beautiful Himalayan valleys. Explore the breathtaking surroundings of Zuluk, with highlights such as Thambi View Point, Lungthung and Nathang Valley, offering magnificent views of the Eastern Himalayas and, on clear days, stunning sunrise views of Kanchenjunga. Continue your journey to Namchi, a peaceful destination in South Sikkim, where you can visit the impressive Samdruptse Hill and Siddhesvara Dham (Char Dham) while enjoying panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The journey then continues to Darjeeling, one of the most famous hill stations in the Eastern Himalayas, with a scenic route through lush tea gardens and mountain landscapes. During your stay, experience the magical Tiger Hill sunrise, visit Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop, explore the famous tea gardens and enjoy the charming atmosphere of Chowrasta and Mall Road. This carefully planned tour combines the adventure of the Silk Route, the spiritual and scenic beauty of Namchi, and the timeless charm of Darjeeling, making it an ideal holiday for families, couples, nature lovers and travellers seeking a perfect blend of mountains, culture, sightseeing, adventure and relaxation.
highlights: Lungthung & Nathang Valley Kanchenjunga Sunrise Views
Mountain & Valley Views Tiger Hill Sunrise
Tea Garden Visit Himalayan Mountaineering Institute

Later, enjoy free time at Chowrasta and Mall Road for shopping and leisure.
